svg.title: What is shared today and what a future clean-capacity pool would mean
svg.desc: Current executions may share immutable image and dependency layers prepared by the deployment, but each task gets its own new sandbox and cleanup. A future native Docker clean-capacity optimization is only proposed: lease unused clean capacity once, destroy the used sandbox and replenish with new clean capacity. There is no VM backend, used-instance reset pool, or implemented warm pool.
